title: Red Hat Security Advisory: 389-ds-base and redhat-ds security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A security update for Red Hat Directory Server 13.3 for RHEL 10 addresses a command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-19843) in the 389-ds-base package. The flaw involves unescaped LDAP Distinguished Names (DN) in the Cockpit 389 Console LDAP editor, which could allow command injection. Red Hat has released patches as part of this update to fix the issue.
